class.name: cub_mapping/PointCloudTo2DTool
class.description: Interactive tool to convert 3D point clouds to 2D occupancy grid maps. Use mouse to position, scroll to adjust height, Shift+scroll for width, Ctrl+scroll for height range. Press 'z' to activate, left-click to add region.

class.name: cub_mapping/WaypointEditTool
class.description: Interactive tool for creating and editing navigation waypoints. Press 'w' to activate. Scroll wheel to adjust orientation. Left-click to add, Shift+left-click to insert after nearest, left-drag a waypoint to move it, right-click a waypoint to delete it. Use together with the WaypointEditorPanel to select the target group.

class.name: cub_mapping/WaypointEditorPanel
class.description: Panel for managing waypoint groups (create / rename / delete / require_input), selecting the target group of WaypointEditTool, and saving / loading waypoint files.
